title: USD to Unreal Engine Chaos Cloth not working properly
content:
I have some problems using the USD to Unreal Engine Chaos Cloth workflow.

I have followed the official Marvelous Designer tutorial, but noticed my outfits have this strange effect that makes them be almost completely black in the scenes, but not inside the Cloth Asset window.

![eb66b393653a44e2aeee49d9209cb186](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/2569a1d02fc74fe7825bc936ebe5805e/images/eb66b393653a44e2aeee49d9209cb186clothAssetSkeletalMesh.PNG)In the Cloth Asset editor.

![381a38a2aaae4b7e954390e5742f13bc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/2569a1d02fc74fe7825bc936ebe5805e/images/381a38a2aaae4b7e954390e5742f13bcviewportSkeletalMesh.PNG)In the viewport.

I know the best place to ask this kind of question would be in the Unreal Engine forums, but I can't seem to be able to get any help about this problem and surely there's people who have had the same problem at some point.

I could also use LiveSync, but I would end up not having any of the material properties available with a usd file.

Environment:  
\- UE 5.7  
\- Marvelous Designer Personal 2026.0.189

Thank you!
content_description: This page aims to troubleshoot and share solutions for issues encountered when importing USD files into Unreal Engine 5.7 Chaos Cloth, specifically addressing black outfit rendering problems despite following Marvelous Designer tutorials.

title: Morph Target Obj Format export
content:
Hi, I've updated MD to last version, 2026.0, but now when I import object as garment, simulate end export back in obj format, when i try to import back to Daz Studio I've a warning, "Geometry did not match, failed to create morph". Never had this problem before (I've used MD for three years). Export is as always, I've positively checked Studio import making a MT with Blender, so the problem appears be in MD export.

Thanks in advance.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Version 2026.0.305 doesn't fix the problem. Please fix it!

Comment 2: it's just a bug of new version. use the previuos version of MD

Comment 3: The problem is still in version 2026.0.259.Using old 2025 fixes the issue for the same obj.Thanks

Comment 4: I am also having this same issue, my workflow is sending from Daz > Zbrush with GoZ, then export from Zbrush as obj, importing that obj into MD, simulating, and then exporting the obj from MD. The simulation OBJ is then imported back into Daz as a morph using Morph Loader Pro. After the update, Daz says the MD objs don't match and won't import them as morphs. I tried setting a bunch of different export options from MD with no luck. I will be reverting back to the previous version until this issue is fixed.Edit: Confirmed reverting to 2025 fixes the issue for the same obj

Please fill out a ticket at our Contact Us page, and please include:- The OBJ from the new version that is triggering the issue- The same OBJ exported from a previous versionThis way we can be sure if is a bug from the version or a corruption of the file. 🙏🏻

Reply 3: Version 2026.0.239 DON't fix the problem.Thanks

title: CLO/MD LiveSync Editor not showing up in Unreal Engine 5.7
content:
For some reason the CLO/MD LiveSync Editor doesn't appear in the Window menu.

I installed the Substance 3D for Unreal Engine plugin, set DirectX11 and enabled Order Independent Transparency.

I have tried MD LiveSync 2.2.2 from both CONNECT and Fab, even tried 2.2.1 just in case, but it still doesn't show up.

Environment:  
\- UE 5.7  
\- MD LiveSync 2.2.2  
\- Marvelous Designer Personal 2026.0.189

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Starting with LiveSync version 2.0.0, the menu location has been changed.You can change the Select Mode to LiveSync in Editor mode on the top toolbar.
Reply 1: Hi!Thank you so much! I saw many tutorials on how to install it, but didn't notice it was for Unreal Engine 5.4, not 5.5 and forwards.
content_description: This page provides troubleshooting guidance for resolving the issue of the CLO/MD LiveSync Editor not appearing in the Window menu within Unreal Engine 5.7 using Marvelous Designer LiveSync.

title: Update to Marvelous Designer 2026.0 Today!
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/ed12ee696c144726ab0e1cb5abaf2242/images/4f325fee94e1474fb0fee5985320eb60Social%20Media%202026.0%20EN.png)![82b43f45d79946ebae6849f6451a018e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/ed12ee696c144726ab0e1cb5abaf2242/images/82b43f45d79946ebae6849f6451a018e2506d5985c6c4a4aa9855ab773490c45Social%20Media%202026.0%20EN.webp)

# **Marvelous Designer 2026.0 has arrived!**

Our first major update of the year delivers brand new artistic tools to elevate your designs and performance upgrades that eliminate friction. Here’s what to expect:

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YidfV2v9c-Y?start=0

**Lacing**

Adding laces can completely transform a design. But modeling them manually is often a tedious and time-consuming task. Our new Lacing feature simplifies this process, allowing you to create and apply intricate laces intuitively within Marvelous Designer.

**3D Pencil**

Discover a more intuitive way to design with the 3D Pencil. This feature allows you to draw directly onto the avatar’s surface, instantly converting sketches into 3D Pen curves. These curves can be refined using the 3D Pen tool and transformed into 2D patterns via the Flattening tool, providing a seamless bridge between conceptual sketching and pattern creation.

**Preserve 3D Garment Shape on 2D Scaling**

Eliminate the need for manual 3D adjustments after resizing. This new feature allows you to scale 2D patterns while preserving the existing 3D shape. Avoid distortions and save time when pursuing multiple size adjustments or silhouette changes.

**[EveryWear] Template-Based Rigging [Beta]**

Our new Template-Based Rigging allows you to automatically add bones to garments. By reducing the need for manual cleanup, you can achieve reliable, high-quality movement with a fraction of the effort. 

**Toon Shader**

Now you can preview toon-style garments directly in Marvelous Designer. By supporting the standard VRM material (MToon), we’ve made it easier than ever to design clothing for VRChat and other Unity-based VR platforms. Achieve that perfect anime look without leaving your workspace.

# **Update to version 2026.0 today to experience the upgrade!**

For a full look at all of the new features, [_click here_](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/product/newfeature).

title: Notice: a recent issue with CLO/MD LiveSync 2.2.2
content:
Hi everyone!

This was a mistake on our end. CLO/MD LiveSync version 2.2.2 was published on Fab prematurely; it is a newer version meant for CLO / Marvelous Designer 2026.0, which has not been released yet.   
  
If you are encountering an issue where a garment fails to send to Unreal Engine and the progress bar is stuck at 50%, please roll back to version 2.2.1 by following these steps.  
  
1\. .Go to our LiveSync version archive and download version 2.2.1 for UE 5.7. <https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45304267645593-LiveSync-2-version-archive>

  
2\. Next, navigate to the UE 5.7 installation directory (e.g., C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.7\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace).  
  
3\. Then, Delete version 2.2.2, then unzip the downloaded 2.2.1 package and place the entire 'CLOLiveSync' folder into that directory.  
  
Once CLO / Marvelous Designer 2026.0 is released, please make sure to remove version 2.2.1 and download version 2.2.2 directly from the Epic Games Launcher. 🙂

If you are experiencing any other issues with LiveSync or your CLO / Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine workflows, we're here to help!

Cheers,

Bryan

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello! I am currently using UE 5.6 and the MD 2025.2, which means I'd have to download the 2.2.1 version. However when I try to extract it or unzip it, I get these pop-ups:The folder being either empty or corrupt.
content_description: This page provides instructions to revert to LiveSync version 2.2.1 for Unreal Engine 5.7 due to the premature release of version 2.2.2 incompatible with current CLO / Marvelous Designer software.
